headline: Polymerization
title: Polymerization Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Polymerization. What is it? It is a Normal Spell Card. What does it do? Fusion Summon one Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as material. How do you use it? Check your Fusion Monster's material list, then keep those monsters ready in hand or on the field. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
